title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
This picture was taken as Gus W. Thomasson, WPA district director, was inspecting the work on the building which was financed largely by Federal funds through his office in Dallas.

Gus W. Thomasson (right) and Project Superintendent, George H. Lofridge (deceased, January 2, 1942).
notes: Printed page number 201 appears at top right. Title 'THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE' appears at top left. Full-page photograph with caption at bottom identifying Gus W. Thomasson (right) and Project Superintendent George H. Lofridge (noted as deceased January 2, 1942).
